quest.title: Together Under the Fireworks
quest.description: Unexpectedly, this old couple's child is the Tenryou Commission's Imatani Keisuke, an old acquaintance of Sakujirou's. However, the two of them once had a sharp disagreement, and so Yoimiya is unable to use this prior relationship to help Sakujirou out of his bind. As the Tenryou Commission closes in on Naganohara Fireworks, Yoimiya fears that Sakujirou will forever forfeit his chance to fulfill his wish...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x600, Primogem x60, Mora x36825, Guide to Transience x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Follow the road out of the city to look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Morihiko
dialogues.text: ...Be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Morihiko
dialogues.text: This is the Tenryou Commission we're talking about. Please, don't do anything you might live to regret.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: Hi, Yoimiya! Are the weapons to scare away the Great Mujina Youkai ready yet?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, Mr. Ryuunosuke is making them right now. You can go collect them from my house later.

dialogues.speaker: Saika
dialogues.text: Uh... Aren't you gonna play with us, Yoimiya?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I have something important to do right now. I'll be back later on.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: ...But I'll bring you guys some candy next time! The extra-sweet candy, the one you guys love.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Yay-ay! We're gonna get candy, woohoo.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Also, I wanted to ask you guys something. Did you see a bunch of scary-looking men come by here, at all?

dialogues.speaker: Saika
dialogues.text: Yep, we did! It looked like they were chasing someone!

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Are they trying to catch a monster, too?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No, don't worry. It's all just a big misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Be good kids and stay out of trouble, alright? Stay in the city for now, and I'll come play with you after the fireworks start.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: We will! We'll be on our best behavior, especially for you, Yoimiya!

talks.objective: Follow the direction indicated by the children
Approach the Tenryou Commission officers who are blocking the road

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: Sorry, official business. I can't let you pass.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sakujirou and Keisuke are up ahead, right? We need to talk to them about something.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: Didn't you hear me? You're not getting past.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ugh, what a nuisance! Well, you've only got yourself to blame!

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: How dare you impede the work of the Tenryou Commission!

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: You will be punished for your actions!

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: There is nowhere you can escape justice, not even at the edges of the world!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Look at that — the one with the loudest mouth had the fastest feet.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: We can't waste any more time on these guys. Let's push on, they should be just ahead.

talks.objective: Talk to the panicking Tenryou Commission officers
Proceed deeper within to find Sakujirou

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: *panting*... *panting*...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Your skills with the sword have stagnated, Sakujirou...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: You should have known that you stood no chance against me in a duel.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: I never imagined I'd fall into your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: If this is to be my fate, I accept it. I have nothing else to say.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: But your return says that you finally came around to my point of view.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: Whatever you say.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: You will return with me to the Tenryou Commission to await your sentencing.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: The one who made this boat will also be punished.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: It doesn't have to end like this! Don't you have anything else to say to one another!?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Hey, I know you. You're Naganohara's girl, who makes the fireworks... Huh. I know you like to get involved in other people's business, but stay out of this. It does not concern you.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: It's okay, Yoimiya. The past is the past.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Then why did you risk life and limb to get yourself back into Inazuma!? And why were you so reluctant to leave after you got here!?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I'll tell you why, this is why! This is the chance you've been waiting for, to talk everything through!

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I have nothing to say to him.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: He's a criminal, I work for the Tenryou Commission. There was never any room for discussion.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Out of respect for the friendship we once had, I gave him a chance to fight for his freedom. But his skills with the sword are as disappointing now as they ever were.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? And just who do you think you're kidding!?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You left all your subordinates back there to guard the road, making sure no one else followed you here. Seems to me like you were hoping for a chance to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I can see it in your faces. You both have so much to say... and you're just gonna choose to keep it all inside?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Don't flatter yourself. What would you know?

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, leave it. It was just my wishful thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No, I won't leave it! I will not stand by and watch when you haven't even done anything!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Keisuke, you seem to like settling things with a duel. So let's do it your way! I challenge you to a duel!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: If I win, then you need to say everything that's in your heart. No more running from your feelings!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: And the same goes for you, Sakujirou! If I win, you will tell Keisuke exactly why you came back. No matter what the consequences are. You have to tell him everything!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: If you don't say anything now, you may never have another chance!

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: And if you lose?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Then I'll admit to collaborating with Sakujirou and accept the Tenryou Commission's punishment!

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: Yoimiya...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I accept. Let's settle this with a duel.

talks.objective: Talk to Imatani Keisuke and Sakujirou

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: Sir, they are too strong. We need more men...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Stand down.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: Wh—What?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I thought I told you to stay away! Now, stand down!

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitaka
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, Sir... Sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Young lady, you are just as obstinate as Sakujirou was back then.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Why were you so convinced that we had things to say to each other?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Because... Sakujirou may not have told me about you when he came back, but he did order a firework from me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Then, your parents told me what happened between you when you were younger. Once I'd heard the story, I realized that the firework meant something special to you both.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: And that's why I simply refuse to believe that you have nothing to say to each other!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Nobody sets off a firework to feel lonely, do they...

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: The reason I came back is that... I felt lost.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: It wasn't that I'd changed my mind, I just felt that what I'd done in the past was to try to escape from reality.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: I saw the freedom of Mondstadt, the contracts of Liyue, the wisdom of Sumeru, and the justice of Fontaine... It all left a deep impression on me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: I was glad that I'd left Inazuma. But then I happened to hear about the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: I was an escapee, and I was proud of that. But really, what I should have tried to do is take the good things from the outside world and bring them back home.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: So that's why you came back? Out of your naive hope of changing the way things are here?

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: No, I let go of those delusions of grandeur. I just felt that... I never should have run away like that...

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: After all, you never ran away.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: I don't know about you, but life hasn't been easy for me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: But I just had to come back and visit. It was like fate was calling me, and I couldn't ignore it any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: ...Life isn't easy for anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I truly worship the Raiden Shogun. Her ideas are my personal creed, and I desire nothing more than to see her will done.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: But now, my role is to punish violators of the Sakoku Decree and confiscate people's Visions. It's not what I signed up for when I joined the Tenryou Commission...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I do wonder... Am I really doing the right thing?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: The boat is yours.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I couldn't make you stay in Inazuma, but that doesn't mean I want to keep you here by force.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: What will you say to the higher-ups?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Don't worry about that. I'll handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: If you wanna come back, I hear that the process of returning to Inazuma from the outside world is long and complicated. But it can be done.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I will lend you my help. But until then, wait for me out there.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: ...And don't kick the bucket on the way out.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Keisuke.

dialogues.speaker: Sakujirou
dialogues.text: Any chance we could watch the fireworks together?

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Mm. Maybe next time.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'll be demoted for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: It's not like me to give in to childish sentiment like this. I can't explain why I went through with it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That boat...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: It's the one that Sakujirou planned on using for his escape. I asked Yoshitaka and the others to transport it here, citing the Temporary Contraband Storage clause.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Forcing Sakujirou to this spot was also something I had planned all along.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: It's just like you said, Yoimiya. Even though I hadn't fully made up my mind, my actions betrayed my intent...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But I think you did the right thing. And look, now you've managed to resolve the grievance in your heart by talking about it.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I understand now, thank you. I didn't know you were quite so perceptive — you saw right into what I was thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's only because I know your parents so well. They're both really nice people, so I didn't think the apple would fall too far from the tree.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: I had heard that there was a new Naganohara running things these days. A little loud and reckless, maybe but... You live up to the family name.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: By the way, Naganohara Fireworks can reproduce the firework that the two of us set off back then, right? Would you be able to make one for me?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sorry, no can do. Without the slip for reference, I can't make the same one again, and I'm afraid Sakujirou is the one with the slip.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Ah, I see...

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: Never mind, then.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't get too down just yet, though — I mentioned that Sakujirou ordered a firework from me, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I can't make another one, but I'm guessing Sakujirou probably won't be needing his anymore... It'd be a shame for it to go to waste, so I'll make an exception and let you set it off instead.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Keisuke
dialogues.text: ...Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No worries. And don't miss out on the start of the fireworks show.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, the way you took command of that whole situation was amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: What can I say — I like to talk. I'm a strong believer in the power of words.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: If you're not willing to communicate, then the problem just sits there. If you just keep staring at it without doing anything, eventually you'll watch every last opportunity to resolve it slip away before your eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sakujirou and Keisuke can't turn back the clock in their relationship, but... that's no reason to live with remorse.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Anyway, follow me. I'll bring you to the perfect place to watch the fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: My pops will set off the firework that I wanted to give to you.

talks.objective: Go to a place to watch the Fireworks Show

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ahh, that was amazing. It was so beautiful I could weep.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Uh, I didn't actually cry, though, right? I just feel a bit misty-eyed.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, remember that big one that went up first? The gold one?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's the one I had pops make for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon saw it! It was one of the best ones, they won't forget that any time soon!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Haha, that's what I wanted to hear. I was hoping it would leave a deep impression on you guys.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: No matter where your journey takes you, and no matter what hardships might lie ahead, I hope you'll always be able to look back fondly on the fireworks you saw tonight.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I believe that as time goes by, this firework will only grow brighter and more beautiful in your heart.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, and also, you're technically my customers now. Here, this is your paper slip. If you ever wanna see that golden firework again, just come and see me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, Yoimiya, you seemed to turn into a completely different person during the fireworks. You were so quiet, and it was like you couldn't hear anything at all.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, I could hear you. I just have a habit of being silent while I'm watching fireworks.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Quietly watching something you made with your own hands rise into the sky, it feels like a sacred ceremony to me.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You asked me what fireworks mean to me, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, for Kouichi, who built that boat for us, and his friend, Third Sis, fireworks commemorate friendship.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For Keisuke's parents, they commemorate marriage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And for Keisuke and Sakujirou, they were commemorating... hmm.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Unwavering beliefs, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, right! Beliefs!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: As for me...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, to be honest, even though I've thought about it countless times before, I still haven't found an answer.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? Huh... Paimon was expecting something deep and philosophical.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Well, no one has ever asked me this before, so I've never really settled on an answer.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: It was by chance that I happened to be born into the Naganohara family, so it was by chance that I ended up learning this craft from my pops.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: It's also by chance that I've met so many people, learned so many things, and discovered that people associate watching fireworks with the things that are most precious to them.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Fireworks that disappear in a flash of light are probably the furthest thing away from the eternity that our Shogun desires.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But people's feelings don't just disappear, and it's those feelings that give fireworks their purpose. If nobody wanted to watch fireworks, then they wouldn't exist.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's another kind of eternity.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Also, consider this: You have to have the Naganoharas, because so many people are emotionally invested in the existence of fireworks.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If we didn't exist, their wishes would go unfulfilled, wouldn't they?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: #You know, {NICKNAME}, I don't really think about complicated things like this very often...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But I'm proud that I was born into the Naganohara family, and have the chance to make so many pretty fireworks.

choices.text: Once again, the Naganoharas live up to their name.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Saburou
dialogues.text: I'm sorry that we weren't much help.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Kaori
dialogues.text: One day, though, that child is going to have to face up to his feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Imatani Kaori
dialogues.text: This is one life lesson that he can't learn from his parents.

dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: Things aren't boding well for Sakujirou.

dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: If only there was something we could do...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: It's Matsuzaka and his friends! Let's ask them!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: It looks like this is the right way. Let's keep going!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: If Sakujirou still hasn't made up his mind, I guess I'll have to step in...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Look, there are people from the Tenryou Commission over there! That must be them.
